name: patient_is_undergoing_cholecystectomy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing a cholecystectomy procedure.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing a cholecystectomy procedure.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently undergoing a cholecystectomy procedure.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently undergoing a cholecystectomy procedure.

name: patient_is_undergoing_cholecystectomy_now@@emergency_procedure
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the cholecystectomy is performed as an emergency procedure.
when_true: Set to true if the cholecystectomy is performed as an emergency procedure.
when_false: Set to false if the cholecystectomy is not performed as an emergency procedure.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the cholecystectomy is performed as an emergency procedure.

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of cholecystitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of cholecystitis.

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of gallstone pancreatitis.

name: patient_is_undergoing_cholecystectomy_now@@planned_elective_non_emergency
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the cholecystectomy the patient is currently undergoing is planned, elective, and non-emergency.
when_true: Set to true if the cholecystectomy the patient is currently undergoing is planned, elective, and non-emergency.
when_false: Set to false if the cholecystectomy the patient is currently undergoing is not planned, elective, or is an emergency.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the cholecystectomy is planned, elective, and non-emergency.
